item.description: I started wearing makeup at 13, but I can count on one hand the lipsticks I’ve used all the way to the last swipe. item.title: 14 Niacinamide Skincare Products To Try For Clearer, Brighter Skin
item.description: For virtually all of my teen years, I blasted my face with salicylic acid and benzoyl peroxide — anything that claimed to target acne, I slathered with reckless abandon. item.title: I Took Trend Inspo From The R29 Lookbook To Dress Up For NYFW
item.description: As a fashion writer, dressing up for New York Fashion Week is both exhilarating and daunting to me (especially during the February shows when a winter coat can make or break your outfit). Do I opt for an all-black, NY journalist uniform? Do I try to go all out like one of the Getty-photographed fashion darlings? Or do I dress on-theme for specific shows? Decisions, decisions!At this point, I’ve grown accustomed to the chaos and long days of NYFW, so I like to plan my outfits well ahead of time.
